title: Noodle missing from Generation trigger filter list
reality: v2.3.4 added Noodle to Lorebook entry Generation filters, so an entry can be restricted to Noodle timeline context without leaking into chat/continue/autonomous generation paths (#3842). The trigger list and generationTriggerFilters field row have no Noodle option; the v2.2 Noodle note implies only chat-level opt-in control.
fix: Add 'noodle' to the trigger list in 'Generation Trigger Types & Folders' with a (v2.3.4, #3842) note; cross-reference from the Noodle paragraph in the Scope section.

title: Semantic matches now share keyword matches' context-budget priority
reality: v2.3.4 gave current semantic lorebook matches the same context-budget priority as current keyword matches: configured entry order — not activation method — decides which entries fit. The v2.2 vector-fallback framing leaves readers to plausibly assume keyword matches outrank semantic ones under budget pressure (which was true before 2.3.4).
fix: Add to 'Token Budget Management' (and/or the vector-fallback paragraph): '(v2.3.4) Semantic/vector matches get the same context-budget priority as keyword matches — configured entry order decides what is attached when everything can't fit.'

title: Entry content now reaches the model verbatim (no HTML-escaping)
reality: v2.3.4 stopped HTML-escaping angle brackets in prompt leaf content: lorebook entry content reaches the model verbatim. Supersedes #3108 and the hardened-prompt-assembly escaping; framework structural wrappers and agent value/attribute escapers unchanged. Authors previously saw XML-like tags in entries get corrupted.
fix: Add a note under 'Entry length' in Best Practices (or near the content field description): '(v2.3.4) Entry content is emitted verbatim — angle brackets are no longer HTML-escaped, so XML-style tags and inline HTML in entry content reach the model exactly as written.'

title: Roleplay Active Context lorebook details now match Conversation/Game
reality: v2.3.4 matched Roleplay's Active Context lorebook details to Conversation and Game: activation sources, matched keys, semantic scores, current-location grouping, budget skips, and expandable entry content (#3840).
fix: Update the World Info Inspector bullet in 'UI Location' with the full detail set and (v2.3.4) Roleplay parity note; update the budget-skip sentence in 'Token Budget Management' to note this visibility now exists in Roleplay too.

title: Embedded-lorebook survival guarantees (PATCH deep-merge, unknown-property preservation) undocumented
reality: v2.3.4 fixed two embedded-lorebook persistence hazards: partial Character PATCHes deep-merge preserving embedded-lorebook data (#3858), and native card validation preserves unknown embedded-lorebook properties (#3859) — relevant for imported cards carrying nonstandard embedded-lorebook fields.
fix: Append the (v2.3.4) guarantees to the 'Character Lorebook tab' bullet in 'Editor conveniences'.
